title: Generate and share attributable architecture views
description: Customers can generate, copy and read a portable architecture snapshot of a selected project, understanding its engineering facts, rationale, provenance and limits without authoring a second model. Sharing remains an explicit user action.

includes: Generate and inspect the five REM architecture perspectives from selected supported inputs.
Read a complete copied snapshot offline with attribution and explicit missing/proposed information.
Preserve selected source meaning and existing output through diagnosed generation failures.
excludes: Editing engineering truth, hosted collaboration, automatic publication and operational-history export.
A particular renderer, package format or claim of design completeness.

sources.locator: FEAT-022; existing Functions support definition presentation, navigation and interpretation only; complete generation and portability realization remains System Design work.
sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
